messages.text:
"Create a complete playable 3D first-person horror game called \"THE LAST SHIFT\".

GAME CONCEPT:
The player is a night security guard trapped inside an abandoned building during a night shift. Strange noises come from dark corridors, lights flicker, and a mysterious creature is hunting the player.

GAMEPLAY:

- First-person 3D camera.
- Mobile-friendly touch joystick for movement.
- Touch controls for camera rotation.
- Sprint button.
- Flashlight with a working ON/OFF button.
- Interactive doors.
- Collect 3 keys hidden in different rooms.
- Unlock the main exit door after collecting all keys.
- A scary monster that patrols the corridors and chases the player when detected.
- Game over screen if the monster catches the player.
- Victory screen when the player escapes.

ENVIRONMENT:

- A realistic abandoned security building.
- Dark corridors, offices, storage rooms and a reception area.
- Atmospheric lighting and shadows.
- Flickering lights.
- Fog and suspenseful horror atmosphere.
- Detailed 3D environment with furniture and decorations.

AUDIO:

- Ambient horror background sounds.
- Footsteps.
- Door opening sounds.
- Monster sounds.
- Scary sound effects.

UI:

- Main menu with Play button.
- Objective text: Find 3 keys and escape.
- Key collection counter.
- Flashlight battery indicator.
- Pause and restart buttons.

IMPORTANT:
Build an actual playable game, not a static 3D scene or a visual mockup.
Make sure all controls and gameplay mechanics work.
Optimize the game for Android mobile browsers.
Use Three.js if available.
Prioritize functional gameplay over excessive graphics.

Start the game immediately after pressing Play.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
